title: Transannular Cyclization Reaction of Humulene 2,3-Epoxide. Formation of a Compound Shaping TC Conformer
abstract: Abstract                Treatment of humulene 2,3-epoxide (5) with boron trifluoride etherate at 0 °C gave (6E)-(1R*,2R*,3S*,10R*)-3-acetoxy-2,5,5-trimethylbicyclo[8.1.0]undeca-6,9(15)-diene and (4E)-(1S*,2S*,8S*,9S*)-2,8-diacetoxy-2,6,6,9-tetramethylbicyclo[7.2.0]undec-4-ene which corresponded to the transannular bond formation products shaping the CT and TC conformers of 5, respectively.
